caption: The drawing features an octagonal frame with a decorative border. The border is adorned with repeating floral and leaf motifs in muted brown, cream, and yellow colors, with blue accents at the corners. Inside the frame, there is a bouquet of various flowers and leaves. The flowers are colored in shades of red, pink, yellow, purple, and blue, with some having multiple hues within the petals. The leaves are primarily green, with some brown and yellow highlights. The bouquet fills most of the inner space of the octagonal frame, with flowers and stems overlapping and intertwining. The background within the frame is a light cream color, matching the plain background that surrounds the entire composition.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
